description: This file implements an abstract generic Data Access Object for entities in the SalesManager application, providing CRUD operations and query methods for entities extending SalesManagerEntity.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntityDaoImpl
classes.description: An abstract implementation of the SalesManagerEntityDao interface, providing generic CRUD and query capabilities for entities extending SalesManagerEntity.

methods.name: SalesManagerEntityDaoImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity class type based on runtime generic type information.

methods.name: getObjectClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity being managed.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by its class type and ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by its ID.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by a specified field attribute and value.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the provided entity in the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a new entity in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified entity from the database.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the state of the entity from the database.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all entities of the managed type.

methods.name: listByField
methods.description: Lists entities filtered by a specific field attribute and value.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists entities with filtering, pagination, and ordering options.

methods.description: Counts entities filtered by a specific field attribute and value.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts entities matching a filter expression.
